task.text:
[0] Knockout of GHR in adult mice resulted in growth retardation and higher adiposity. Knockout mice displayed improved insulin sensitivity but poor glucose tolerance. Female GHR knockout mice had increased maximal lifespan.

[1] GHR deletion in mice caused dwarfism, enhanced insulin sensitivity, and significantly extended longevity. The average lifespan of GHR −/− Ola-BALB/cJ male mice was significantly longer than their controls.

[2] GHR deletion in mice caused dwarfism, enhanced insulin sensitivity, and significantly extended longevity. The average lifespan of GHR −/− Ola-BALB/cJ female mice was significantly longer than their controls.

[3] GHR knockout mice had impaired growth and significantly lower levels of plasma IGF1 and IGFBP3. The mean lifespan of GHR knockout female mice was significantly longer than that of control mice.

[4] GHR deletion in mice caused dwarfism, enhanced insulin sensitivity, and significantly extended longevity. The average lifespan of GHR −/− C57BL/6J female mice wasnt significantly different from their controls.

[5] GHR knockout mice had impaired growth and significantly lower levels of plasma IGF1 and IGFBP3. The mean lifespan of GHR knockout male mice was significantly longer than that of control mice.

[6] Knockout of GHR in adult mice resulted in growth retardation and higher adiposity. Knockout mice displayed improved insulin sensitivity but poor glucose tolerance. Male knockout mice didn't exhibit a difference in lifespan.

[7] Female mice with GHR knockout had improved lifespan. The maximum and minimum life expectancy are indicated by survival curves (90th and 10th percentile, respectively). The numbers of animals are approximate according to the survival curves, the article states that there were 23-43 animals in each group.

[8] Male mice with muscle-specific GHR knockout had improved glucose metabolism, smaller body size, decreased lean mass, and lived longer than control.

[9] Female mice with muscle-specific GHR knockout had improved glucose metabolism, bigger body size, and increased lean mass, but the same lifespan as control.

Each numbered passage describes one lifespan experiment. For each, report three things using ONLY that passage:
  organism: the model organism studied, one lowercase word
  direction: exactly one of 'increases lifespan', 'decreases lifespan', or 'no change'
  method: how the gene was altered, e.g. gene knockout, overexpression, mutation, knockdown

Output one block per passage, in order, formatted exactly:
[0]
organism: ...
direction: ...
method: ...

Nothing else. If a passage does not state something, write 'unstated'.
